codex_note:
## Codex adaptation and security boundary

This is a per-turn native Codex guidance adapter. It preserves the 23 playbooks and their principles, but it does not create a sticky mode or claim implicit future invocation. Read the selected playbook from the project-local mirror. Map the upstream question action to the host's optional user-input surface only for a genuine product or preference choice. Map the upstream task and delegation fields to native bounded delegation when exposed, keeping scope, selected model/effort, ownership, and proof with the coordinator. If delegation is unavailable, use the labeled sequential fallback. For cleanup, use `cursor-deslop` when installed; for CLI/TUI surfaces, use `cursor-control-cli`; for browser/Electron/web surfaces, use `cursor-control-ui`. Check each concrete skill before use and record the exact gap when unavailable or not applicable. Cloud-capable task environments are conditional; if the cloud lane is unavailable, record the gap and do not claim parity. Keep model selection with model-capability-router and proof-path selection with proof-orchestrator. A heartbeat or automation is used only when explicitly requested. The pinned upstream `pstack/agents/poteto-agent.md` is bundled as [a native role reference](references/poteto-agent.md). Give that full role to a bounded delegate and reuse the same native delegate for this conversation when supported. Automatic sticky routing and cross-turn reuse remain unproven.

This candidate remains unindexed. Finding review: bundled-script-review at scripts/**:n/a (bundled_executable_surface); executable-file at scripts/check-plan.mjs,scripts/worktree-audit.sh,scripts/orch/orch.ts,scripts/watch-pr/watch-pr:n/a (active_executable_surface); dependency-manifest-surface at scripts/package.json:n/a (active_dependency_surface). Do not install dependencies or activate the bundled scripts until code, dependency, and egress behavior is reviewed.
codex_rule: Respect native Codex model/effort, permissions and actual tool availability; no automatic Cursor runtime equivalence.
preserved_requirement: poteto's agent style for concise, detailed responses, deliberate subagents, unslopped prose, simple code, and verified work. Use for poteto, /poteto-mode, or requests to work in this style.
proof: Pinned source hash and deterministic renderer are static provenance. Focused tests render all 23 playbooks and structurally read one exact playbook in an isolated fixture with missing and malformed cases. The pinned poteto-agent role is bundled but not runtime-invoked. Contextual step application, bundled scripts, cloud task execution, and a live native session remain unproven.
reason: The adapter preserves the full source tree while making the runtime mapping, no-sticky boundary, native authority, and executable-script hold explicit.
